title: alchemilla vulgaris var. glomerulans
intro: Alchemilla vulgaris var. glomerulans, commonly known as the cluster-lipped lady's mantle, is a variant of the lady's mantle plant species. It is a perennial herb native to Europe and Western Asia, known for its medicinal properties and ornamental value. The health benefits of A. vulgaris var. glomerulans include its use as a uterine tonic and anti-inflammatory agent, making it helpful in alleviating menstrual cramps, bloating, and other symptoms associated with PMS. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its ability to stimulate digestion, soothe skin irritations, and act as a mild diuretic, which is attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and volatile oils.
